pages.title: About EvaraNest
pages.body:
EvaraNest is a luxury handmade candle atelier crafting soy wax, beeswax and signature scent collections for everyday warmth and thoughtful gifting.

Every pour is made in small batches in India — clean ingredients, gift-ready packaging, and fragrances composed to feel personal.

pages.title: Work with Us
pages.body:
We partner with stylists, event planners, and retailers who share a love for calm, scented spaces.

Write to us via Contact for collaborations, wholesale, or custom pours.

pages.title: Candle Care
pages.body:
Trim the wick to 5mm before every burn.

Allow the wax pool to reach the edges on the first burn (2–3 hours).

Never burn for more than 4 hours at a time.

Keep away from drafts, pets, and flammable materials.

Discontinue use when 1cm of wax remains.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
We collect only what we need to fulfil orders, improve the storefront, and support you — name, contact details, shipping address, and order history.

We do not sell personal data. Payment details are processed by our payment partner and are not stored on this site.

pages.body: By placing an order with EvaraNest you agree that product colours may vary slightly from screen to life, personalised items are final sale unless damaged, and delivery timelines are estimates subject to courier partners.

pages.title: Shipping Policy
